releaseNotes: PRD v2.0 Local-First Upgrade: strict dual-port public/admin isolation (:8787 vs :3838), built-in Windows SQLite (WAL, 7 tables), DPAPI secret encryption, 4MiB resumable session uploads with magic-byte validation & 6-char receipts, native Image-to-PDF + LibreOffice worker, First-Run Wizard, Pause Receiving, Light/Dark mode, and all 9 Windows file actions.
